coding_scope: Record-level textual interpretation of archived source fields; deterministic namespace and stage-qualified resolution. The supplied interpretations do not constitute independent adjudication.

record_fields.skb_adoption_documented: A provenance relation expressly attributes treatment to a named SKB historical/current assessment element; stage remains explicit.
record_fields.current_skb_adoption_documented: The relation expressly documents affirmative SR-Site adoption as the basis of the current exclusion; mere retained fields or earlier-stage comments do not qualify.
record_fields.skb_discussion_coverage_assertion_presen: A supplementary SKB discussion states that described source aspects are treated elsewhere; excludes the formulaic RELEVANCE MOTIVATION.
record_fields.skb_discussion_targeted_assertion_presen: That statement names a treatment destination/family or explicitly refers to a process list, even if its exact version or member cannot be resolved.
record_fields.skb_discussion_scope_rationale_present: The supplementary SKB discussion identifies source aspects and how they are assigned to, or excluded from, treatment.
